basis: Exact source/build lineage is checked before cooking; all modules named by the current UnrealEditor.modules manifest are copied and byte-verified. Both gameplay and loading modules are covered.

The ground flag is surfaces-only; visible state requires cosmetic collision/navigation invariants, material and bounds. Hidden mode deliberately fails visibility after native success and preserves the captured control result.

The aggregate checks current source, native binary, cook snapshot, safe configuration repair, stage/archive extraction and four isolated runtime identities. Ten matched static camera poses yield forty ground-region checks with an existing-street comparison.
The known generated cook configuration is restored only through the existing bounded repair verifier. Raw private side-effect configuration and token contents are excluded from repository evidence.
scope_limits: Review accepts this bounded package qualification, not D03 completion or owner art acceptance.
Prior optional local review timeouts do not supply a provider verdict. No repeat provider request was needed for this persisted direct review.
